title: symphyotrichum walteri
intro: Symphyotrichum walteri, commonly known as Walter's Aster, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that can aid in the treatment of wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Symphyotrichum walteri include its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, making it useful for anxiety and stress relief, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties that can help reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
